nina_marketing: Heads-up 18: final checklist for Jun 21 virtual session. Need agreement on: reg form fields, Zoom record settings, and post-event lead routing + clip plan. Short run-of-show below.

sam_ops: Zoom: cloud record ON, cloud transcript ON, save chat ON. Enable separate audio tracks for panelists. Host should start local backup if possible.

jo_content: Reg form: name + email required, company/title optional. Add a single-select: 'Primary use case' (prototyping, product, infra). Add consent for marketing. Keep CTA: "Reserve my seat".

eli_media: Post-recording plan: when files land I'll pull MP4 + SRT, run `clipper --highlights 3` and upload assets to /GDrive/Events/June21. Need HubSpot tag to surface top Qs for creative.

ava_growth: HubSpot flow: form -> contact -> add tag = webinar_jun21 -> set property last_webinar = jun21 -> if 'interested_in_pilot' create AE task. Also add list 'webinar_followup'.

filebot: [automation] Zoom watcher active. Will post when cloud MP4 + transcript appear in folder `zoom-cloud/redwood/jun21`.

nina_marketing: Rehearsal tomorrow 8:50am PT. Please join early for mic checks. Final checklist: reg fields -> jo ✅, zoom config -> sam ✅, hubspot flow -> ava ✅, media pipeline -> eli ✅. Locking thread.
